title: Desmin filaments extend along actin filaments within the mouse skeletal muscle sarcomere
task: Determine 3D spatial organization of desmin intermediate filaments within muscle sarcomeres
key_results: Desmin filaments extend from Z-lines into sarcomere interior aligned with actin filaments; disruption of desmin assembly reduces active tension at longer sarcomere lengths
comments: Super-resolution microscopy reveals a more complex desmin architecture than the traditional Z-line confinement model, with direct functional consequences for force production.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Desmin filaments are confined to Z-lines
hypotheses.result: Refuted; desmin extends into sarcomere interior aligned with actin

hypotheses.hypothesis: Desmin contributes to force production, particularly at longer sarcomere lengths
hypotheses.result: Supported; selective tension reduction at longer lengths upon desmin disruption

title: Common misconceptions in life sciences about the concentrations and toxicity of perchlorates on Mars
task: Clarify perchlorate concentration and toxicity misconceptions for Mars habitability research
key_results: Identified systematic misconceptions in perchlorate exposure levels and toxicity mechanisms affecting Mars exploration planning
comments: This is primarily a review/perspective article correcting the scientific record rather than presenting novel experimental findings.

title: Spatial reprogramming of AP-1 complexes by mutant p53 flips the transcriptional output of the FOSL1 enhancer-promoter axis to drive migration
task: Elucidate how mutant p53 reprograms AP-1 complexes to drive EMT and cell migration
key_results: Mutant p53 redirects c-JUN/FRA1 complexes from CREs in FOSL1 intron 1 (repressive, wtp53) to TREs in FOSL1 promoter (activating, mutp53), establishing self-reinforcing FRA1 activation loop
comments: The locus-specific spatial reprogramming mechanism is elegant, but therapeutic targeting of mutp53-AP-1 interactions may face selectivity challenges given AP-1's pleiotropic roles.

model_io.model: FOSL1 enhancer-promoter axis in cancer cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mutant p53 flips FOSL1 transcriptional output by spatial reprogramming of AP-1 complexes from enhancer to promoter
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mutp53 redirects c-JUN/FRA1 to TREs in promoter vs wtp53/c-JUN/ATF2 at CREs in intron 1

hypotheses.hypothesis: FOSL1 spatial reprogramming drives pro-migratory EMT progression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mutp53-driven FRA1 activation correlates with enhanced migration

title: Heparan sulfate sulfatases are essential for the patterning of human stem cell-derived midbrain dopaminergic neurons
task: Identify extracellular regulators controlling midbrain dopaminergic neuron patterning from human iPSCs
key_results: SULF1/2 knockout increases 6-O-sulfated heparan sulfate and disrupts anteroposterior/dorsoventral patterning; double-knockout cells adopt hindbrain/spinal cord/neural crest fates instead of ventral midbrain; FGF inhibition partially rescues midbrain fate but not ventral identity
comments: The finding that heparan sulfate sulfatases regulate neural patterning via extracellular mechanisms is novel, though FGF signaling alone does not fully explain the patterning defect, suggesting additional SULF1/2-dependent pathways remain to be identified.

model_io.model: Human iPSC-derived midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
outputs: alternative cell fates (hindbrain, spinal, neural crest)

hypotheses.hypothesis: SULF1/2 are essential for mDA neuron patterning in vitro
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SULF1/2 knockout disrupts both anteroposterior and dorsoventral patterning

hypotheses.hypothesis: SULF1/2-mediated patterning is primarily driven by altered FGF signaling
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; FGF inhibition redirects toward midbrain fates but does not restore ventral identity

title: A quantitative deep-learning-based framework reveals a continuum of chromatin sensitivities across transcription factors
task: Quantitative assessment of chromatin sensitivity across transcription factors
key_results: Demonstrated chromatin sensitivity is a continuum across TFs, dependent on motif strength, indicating regulatory activation by mixed hierarchical and cooperative mechanisms
comments: Sophisticated framework resolving competing models of TF binding, though mechanistic insights into the mixture of mechanisms remain incomplete.

hypotheses.hypothesis: TF binding is purely hierarchical or purely cooperative
hypotheses.result: Refuted; found to be a locus-specific mixture of both mechanisms

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chromatin sensitivity depends on motif strength
hypotheses.result: Supported

title: Late-stage clinical development pathways for Lassa fever vaccines: scientific, operational, and regulatory considerations
task: Clinical development pathway assessment for Lassa fever vaccines
key_results: Exploration of conventional and alternative regulatory pathways to advance vaccine candidates beyond Phase 2 given low incidence and lack of protection biomarker
comments: Policy/regulatory analysis rather than empirical study; identifies a critical gap in clinical trial design for rare tropical diseases.

title: Explainable machine learning for genomic prediction, subgroup classification, and optimal parent cross ranking in rice breeding using 1k-RiCA SNP data
task: Explainable genomic prediction and parent cross ranking in rice breeding
key_results: XGBoost best for flowering time (R²=0.69), random forest best for plant height (R²=0.55); random forest achieved 76.7% subgroup classification accuracy; ranked 62,128 pairwise crosses via web application
comments: Practical translation of genomic selection with interpretability, but grain yield exclusion due to G×E interaction limits comprehensive breeding utility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Grain yield is predictable from SNP markers using genomic selection
hypotheses.result: Refuted (rrBLUP R²=0.115±0.061); attributed to strong G×E interaction

title: TransAct: efficient attention-based temporal modelling for real-time wearable human activity recognition
task: Efficient temporal modeling of wearable sensor streams for human activity recognition
key_results: TransAct (Transformer) vs CNN-LSTM: UCI HAR 95.10% vs 94.26% (p=0.050, non-significant Wilcoxon), PAMAP2 86.13% vs 82.75% (p=0.012), OPPORTUNITY macro-F1 54.15% vs 51.55% (p=0.030); TransAct 2–3× slower
comments: Honest reporting of mixed results with statistical rigor; demonstrates that architectural advantage is dataset-dependent and comes with computational cost, contradicting 'efficiency' claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transformer architecture is computationally efficient and universally superior for wearable HAR
hypotheses.result: Partially refuted; accuracy gains on 2/3 benchmarks but 2–3× higher inference latency

hypotheses.hypothesis: Positional encoding, multi-head attention, and layer normalization are individually necessary
hypotheses.result: Refuted via ablation (p>0.9 for each component)

title: Automatic detection of osteomeatal complex obstruction, concha bullosa, and nasal septal deviation using deep learning
task: Deep learning detection of nasal anatomical abnormalities on CBCT images
key_results: YOLO11m achieved ~99% mAP@0.5 for concha bullosa, 94.3% for maxillary sinus ostium, 99.5% for nasal septal deviation on test set
comments: Strong performance across two CBCT devices, though clinical utility requires prospective validation and comparison to radiologist assessment.

outputs: detection of concha bullosa, nasal septal deviation, maxillary sinus ostium status

title: DLFL-TLDNet: hybrid AI model integrating deep learning and fuzzy logic for tomato leaf disease classification and severity estimation
task: Tomato leaf disease classification and severity estimation
key_results: InceptionV3 achieved 97.91% test accuracy across 10 disease categories; fuzzy logic system provided interpretable severity scoring at Primary/Medium/Extreme levels
comments: Strength in combining deep learning with fuzzy logic for interpretability, though severity validation metrics not quantitatively reported.

title: Stromal enriched metastatic decider drives lymph node metastasis in lung adenocarcinoma
task: Identification of metastasis-associated spatial niches in lung adenocarcinoma
key_results: Defined stromal-enriched metastatic decider (SEED) spots via transcriptional proximity mapping; identified CYP24A1 as spatially enriched marker associated with poorer prognosis and IFNγ-associated transcriptional features
comments: Innovative spatial transcriptomic approach links primary tumor heterogeneity to nodal dissemination; CYP24A1 and POSTN interactions merit functional validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SEED regions mark metastasis-associated spatial niches at tumor-stroma interfaces
hypotheses.result: Supported by spatial localization and CYP24A1 enrichment

hypotheses.hypothesis: CYP24A1 is a spatial biomarker of lymph node metastatic risk
hypotheses.result: Supported by prognosis association and RNAscope/multiplex IF validation

title: Multimodal digital biomarker for asthma: complementary roles of vocal, clinical and demographic factors
task: Asthma identification via multimodal biomarkers integrating voice and clinical data
key_results: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model achieved AUROC 0.83 and Brier score 0.18, outperforming unimodal approaches on 1218 cases
comments: Novel integration of acoustic and clinical modalities is promising, but self-reported asthma without spirometry confirmation limits clinical relevance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Respiratory symptom burden correlates with increased weighting of reading-passage modality in asthma cases
hypotheses.result: Supported by exploratory gating analysis

title: Robust adaptive model-free tracking control via ACRL-based dynamic gains FOESO of LIM drive for transportation systems applications
task: Robust adaptive control of linear induction motor drives via ACRL
key_results: RAMFTC with RBFNN-based ACRL adaptively tunes observer/control gains; MF-FOISMC maintains stability under uncertainties and disturbances; Lyapunov stability proven; outperforms other control schemes in experiments
comments: Sophisticated control architecture combining reinforcement learning, neural networks, and fractional-order systems; practical validation results limited to simulation or single test scenario.

model_io.model: Actor-Critic RL (RBFNN) + fractional-order integral sliding-mode control + dynamic-gains extended state observer

hypotheses.hypothesis: ACRL can adaptively tune controller gains without explicit system model
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: online adaptation via RBFNN successfully handles uncertainties

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fractional-order formulation improves robustness over integer-order
hypotheses.result: Supported by experimental superiority but isolated ablation not fully detailed

title: Deep reinforcement learning with modified red fox optimizer based task scheduling scheme for human–robot collaboration
task: Real-time task scheduling in human-robot collaboration systems
key_results: DRL-MRFO achieved lowest completion time 74 min (vs 82–115 min for baselines on Product-1); robot utilization up to 92.87% in 1H-1R scenarios; consistent improvements across multiple configurations
comments: Effective integration of DQN with hyperparameter optimization; however, comparison primarily against weaker baselines (DP, Nash-Q) with limited ablation of MRFO contribution.

model_io.model: Deep Q-Network (DQN) + Modified Red Fox Optimizer (MRFO)
inputs: HRC system state (task queues, robot/human availability)

hypotheses.hypothesis: DRL-MRFO outperforms DP, Nash-Q, and DQN variants
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: across Product-1, Product-2, and multiple H-R configurations

hypotheses.hypothesis: MRFO hyperparameter tuning improves DQN performance
hypotheses.result: Supported by experimental results but isolated ablation not fully reported

title: Comparison of chisel tine draft requirements using analytical, experimental, and numerical methods
task: Predicting chisel tine draft requirements via multiple approaches
key_results: FEM achieved excellent accuracy (<3.3% difference except 2 cases); ASABE poor (<33.2%); McKyes-Ali good (<7%); optimal blade rake angle 15°; forward speed and depth significantly interact (P<0.01)
comments: Rigorous multi-method comparison with field validation; FEM's superiority is convincing but computationally costlier than analytical approaches.

model_io.model: FEM (Eulerian-Lagrangian) in ABAQUS; McKyes-Ali equation; ASABE D497.7 equation

hypotheses.hypothesis: FEM predicts field results more accurately than analytical methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: paired t-test sig=0.263 only for FEM vs field (not significant)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Blade rake angle of 15° minimizes draft
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in numerical parameter sweep

title: Quantum resistant hybrid hash framework using BLAKE3 KDF for secure data integrity
task: Post-quantum data integrity via hybrid hash construction
key_results: 512-bit output with BLAKE3 KDF + SHA-512 achieves 100% tamper detection; near-optimal avalanche behavior; strong collision resistance; 732.9 MB/s throughput (16.8% reduction vs SHA-512 alone)
comments: Addresses genuine quantum threat to hash functions but formal security analysis is deferred; cryptographic monoculture mitigation via hybrid design is sensible but requires peer review.

model_io.model: BLAKE3 KDF + SHA-512 hybrid hash + HMAC authenticated integrity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid construction resists quantum attacks better than single hash
hypotheses.result: Supported by security modeling tests; formal proof deferred

hypotheses.hypothesis: 100% tamper detection achievable across threat models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in experimental evaluation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid overhead is acceptable (<20%)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 16.8% throughput reduction at 64 KB input

title: PATBox for reproducible benchmarking of photoacoustic reconstruction
task: Benchmarking photoacoustic computed tomography reconstruction methods
key_results: Metric-dependent method rankings identified; delay-and-sum optimal for NRMSE/correlation; detector bandwidth produces largest degradation; FEM approach validated across controlled studies
comments: Comprehensive simulation-based framework but lacks real experimental validation; important finding that strong background suppression may lose weak structures.

model_io.model: k-Wave simulation + multiple reconstruction methods (delay-and-sum, sign-coherence-factor DAS, time reversal)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Method rankings are metric-dependent
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: different algorithms rank first under different metrics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Detector bandwidth has largest degradation impact
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through sequential physical-degradation analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Background suppression preserves branching structure
hypotheses.result: Refuted: strong suppression can lose weak structures

title: ConvLSTM-DynAE: dynamic deep embedded clustering for smart meter load profiling
task: Smart meter load profiling via deep embedded clustering
key_results: ConvLSTM-DynAE achieves superior Silhouette, Davies–Bouldin, and Calinski–Harabasz indices on London and Ireland datasets; dynamic optimization strategy mitigates Feature Randomness and Feature Drift
comments: Well-motivated architecture combining temporal modeling with stable clustering, but evaluation limited to unsupervised metrics without downstream task validation.

model_io.model: ConvLSTM autoencoder with dynamic clustering objective
inputs: smart meter consumption time-series (London, Ireland datasets)

hypotheses.hypothesis: ConvLSTM captures temporal dependencies better than conventional methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: outperforms conventional and existing deep clustering baselines

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic optimization improves clustering stability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: mitigates Feature Randomness and Feature Drift

title: Strain-driven and electric-field-tunable self-morphotropic phase boundary in nitride perovskite
task: Engineer ultrahigh piezoelectricity via strain-driven morphotropic phase boundary in nitride perovskite
key_results: LaWN3 exhibits piezoelectric coefficients orders of magnitude higher than AlN, AlScN, GaScN; electric-field tunable self-morphotropic phase boundary enables polarization rotation under biaxial strain
comments: First-principles prediction of SMPB in nitrides is promising but lacks experimental validation of claimed ultrahigh piezoelectric responses.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Biaxial strain induces sequential symmetry transitions enabling polarization rotation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via DFT; ultrahigh piezoelectricity achieved

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electric field dynamically tunes the SMPB
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; enables enhanced piezoelectric response

title: Microstructural changes in radiochromic film and dosimetry in magnetic field
task: Validate radiochromic film dosimetry reliability in magnetic fields for MR-guided radiotherapy
key_results: Crystal structures align within ±80–100° under magnetic field (vs random 360° distribution) but optical density remains within experimental uncertainty; EBT-3 RCF dosimetric accuracy maintained
comments: Microstructural reorientation without dosimetric effect is a valuable mechanistic insight resolving conflicting literature.

model_io.model: EBT-3 radiochromic film irradiated in MR-linear accelerator

hypotheses.hypothesis: Magnetic field affects crystal structure orientation but not polymerized material quantity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; angular alignment pronounced but optical density unchanged

hypotheses.hypothesis: Magnetic field compromises dose measurement accuracy
hypotheses.result: Refuted; dosimetric differences negligible within experimental uncertainty

title: Comparative investigation of various optical properties, birefringence, and order parameter of pure 5CB and its fully and partially deuterated samples, 5CB-d19 and 5CB-d8 liquid crystals
task: Characterize temperature-dependent optical properties of deuterated 5CB liquid crystals
key_results: Crossover temperatures: 5CB 271.42 K, 5CB-d19 271.66 K, 5CB-d8 292.24 K; four-parameter model validated across pure and deuterated variants
comments: Systematic comparison is methodologically sound but provides incremental insights without novel physical phenomena or applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Four-parameter model accurately predicts refractive indices for deuterated variants
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; model validated via two-step fitting

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deuteration shifts crossover temperature
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 5CB-d8 shows 20.82 K shift relative to 5CB

title: Full-comb photon-flux modeling beyond the nearest-mode approximation in air-cladded silicon nitride microrings
task: Design broadband integrated photon-pair source via SFWM in air-cladded silicon nitride microring
key_results: Quantum frequency comb with ~450 signal-idler pairs spanning 45.2 THz (362 nm); maximum photon flux 2.88 MHz; full-comb analysis reveals dispersion and cavity resonance matching jointly determine spectral extent
comments: Full-comb modeling beyond nearest-mode approximation is rigorous but prediction lacks experimental demonstration of claimed 450-pair generation.

model_io.model: SFWM in air-cladded Si₃N₄ microring with dispersion engineering

hypotheses.hypothesis: Air-cladding with dispersion engineering enables broadband QFC with ~450 pairs
hypotheses.result: Predicted via full-comb modeling; 45.2 THz spectral span achieved

hypotheses.hypothesis: Favorable generation conditions near pump guarantee broadband operation
hypotheses.result: Refuted; simultaneous dispersion and cavity resonance matching required across spectrum

title: Ensemble learning-based surrogate modeling of a four-port self-isolated MIMO antenna for V2X and X-band wireless applications
task: Develop ensemble learning surrogate model for compact four-port MIMO antenna optimization
key_results: Stacking ensemble achieves R²=0.9956, RMSE=0.464, MAE=0.198 on 9,505 unseen geometries; antenna covers V2X/X-band/Ku-band with 23–35 dB isolation; SAR <1.60 W/kg
comments: High-performance surrogate model based on 93,149 simulations is pragmatic for design-space exploration but extrapolation beyond training domain untested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orthogonal four-port arrangement with optimized spacing reduces mutual coupling
